title: s31z ladder VERDICT:  3e19/9e19/3e20 OOM even at dps-15 (memory = N x term-cost,  N = sqrt(t/2pi),  term-cost ~ precision-INDEPENDENT ~ 53-62 B);  machine zeta wall locked at [9e18,  3e19) for ALL mpmath precisions;  s31z2 launched:  the 5e8G (t = 1.5e19) zeta probe -  the LAST reachable height (model 83-95 GB vs  110 GB available)
body: s31z  LADDER  VERDICT  (scripts/rh/s31z_wall_ladder.py,  one  fresh  process  per  height,  dps  ascending,  all  three  children  OOM-killed  by  the  kernel  -  dmesg  11:28:45  /  11:29:10  /  11:29:30,  each  with  anon-rss  ~  115  GB  at  the  global-OOM  line):  (1)  t  =  3e19:  killed  in  its  FIRST  dps-15  call  (total-vm  117  GB,  anon-rss  115.2  GB);  (2)  t  =  9e19:  killed  in  its  first  dps-15  call  (total-vm  134  GB);  (3)  t  =  3e20:  killed  in  its  first  dps-15  call  (total-vm  168  GB).  No  value  was  computed  at  ANY  height  or  precision.  MODEL  (now  pinned  by  four  datapoints  -  9e18  success  73.7  GB  @dps40,  3e19  OOM  @dps40  and  @dps15,  9e19/3e20  OOM  @dps15):  mpmath  RS-zeta  memory  scales  as  N  x  elem  with  N  =  sqrt(t  /  2  pi)  (the  _zetasum_fast  precompute  over  the  1  ..  N-1  harmonic  tail)  and  elem  ~  53.5  B  at  dps-15  (calibrated  from  the  3e19/dps15  total-vm  117  GB)  up  to  ~  61.6  B  at  dps-40  (calibrated  from  the  9e18  peak  73.7  GB  at  N  =  1.197e9)  -  i.e.  the  per-term  cost  is  DOMINATED  BY  THE  PRECOMPUTE  STRUCTURE  AND  IS  NEARLY  PRECISION-INDEPENDENT  (a  2.6x  precision  cut  buys  only  ~  2.5%  memory)  -  so  low-precision  ladders  do  NOT  move  the  wall.  Implication:  the  machine  zeta  wall  is  LOCKED  at  [9e18,  3e19)  for  ALL  mpmath  precisions,  and  N  =  1.197e9  terms  (73.7  GB)  is  the  largest  precompute  that  fits  with  headroom  -  everything  at  N  >=  ~  1.7e9  (t  >=  ~  1.8e19)  OOMs  even  at  dps-15.  THE  LAST  REACHABLE  HEIGHT  (s31z2,  in  flight  now):  t  =  5e8  .  G_LAST  =  1.5000523e19  gives  N  =  1.545e9  ->  model  peak  82.7  GB  (dps-15)  ..  95.2  GB  (dps-40),  UNDER  the  ~  110  GB  available  with  ~  15  GB  headroom.  Protocol  (scripts/rh/s31z2_5e8G_zeta.py,  supervisor  pid  2993775,  taskset  0-31,  staggered):  ONE  FRESH  PROCESS  PER  DPS  (15  ->  20  ->  30  ->  40,  in  order)  -  fresh  per  call  because  pymalloc  arenas  are  not  returned  to  the  OS  between  calls  (a  single  multi-dps  process  would  accumulate  live  RSS  and  turn  later  calls  into  an  OOM  lottery);  the  dps-40  value  is  the  census  working  channel,  dps-15/20/30  are  independent  precision  crosses;  expected  duration  ~  4.5-5  h  (the  dps-40  zeta  alone  scales  ~ N:  63  min  x  1.545/1.197  ~  81  min).  OUTCOMES:  (a)  dps-40  LANDS:  the  5e8G  census  row  (t  =  1.5e19,  t/G  =  5e8)  becomes  reachable  via  the  STAGGERED  ROW  PROTOCOL  -  stream  process  (la/re  +  lm  +  I_far  channels,  moderate  memory)  +  this  zeta  value  +  exact  f64  merge  -  extending  the  verified  extreme  boundary  9e18  to  1.5e19  and  adding  the  best-leverage  row  reachable  on  this  machine  (t/g0  =  0.5  at  the  best-fit  g0  ~  1e9G,  versus  0.3  for  the  3e8G  row;  still  short  of  the  3e19  =  1e9G  wall  row  that  would  actually  break  the  B7  position-amplitude  degeneracy);  (b)  dps-40  OOMs  (or  any  step  surprises):  the  boundary  STAYS  at  9e18  and  the  far-data  track  closes  at  its  leveraged  wall  on  this  hardware  -  the  only  remaining  levers  are  a  C  zeta  channel  (memory-frugal  Riemann-Siegel,  a  larger  engineering  build)  or  more  RAM.  No  RH  claim.
